summary: Steep kerb directly in front of terraces and apartments, 9-11 m away.
reasons: Homes face the kerb the whole way

best_section.where: North kerb at the east end, below the Oxford apartment blocks

drivers.seclusion: Terraces 9 m away at 13-19 m, Parque on Oxford 10 m at 47 m, The Oxford 11 m at 59 m. No stretch is clear of dwellings.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street; a few cars park at the west end, room at the kerb.
drivers.convention: A few cars park at the west end; apartment frontage, so a van would be noticed.

flags: Steep: about 9% over the best section, 12% max
Dwellings within about 10 m on the same side
No council signs on this stretch
sun_shade: Buildings shade the kerb from the north in the morning and midday; open to afternoon sun.
